source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Waiting until fully definitive proof has been gathered before taking any further reporting action at all","B":"Report the suspicion to the appropriate authorities, since nurses are mandatory reporters in all states for suspected child abuse","C":"Documenting the suspicion somewhere in the record, without taking any further reporting action beyond that step","D":"Confronting the family directly about the suspicion, without involving any outside authorities in the matter"}}
source_row.rationale: Nurses are mandatory reporters in all U.S. states for suspected child abuse; mere suspicion, not definitive proof, is generally sufficient to trigger the legal reporting obligation.
source_row.source_detail: Nurse as Mandatory Reporter for Suspected Abuse
